rules.TypeOK: Every value in the model stays one of its allowed values.
rules.NoStrandedUndo: Once no write is running and the next write has done its recovery, a change is shown as undone only if an undo of it finished.
rules.UndoneMeansFilesBack: An undo is recorded as finished only after its own write of the files ran to the end, and nothing moves the files afterwards.
rules.NoStrandedUndoBeyondIssue787: Once no write is running and the next write has done its recovery, a change is shown as undone only if an undo of it finished. The two gaps that issue 787 reports are left out.
rules.FinishedUndoKeepsClaim: A finished undo keeps its claim: the change stays shown as undone, so it cannot be undone a second time.

steps.YouAskCoreToUndo: You ask for Undo of a change the core wrote (Activity, `skill-studio restore`, or MCP `restore_event`).
steps.AnotherWriteStarts: Another core write starts (park, install, update, remove) and begins its recovery pass.
steps.RecoveryReleasesClaim: Recovery looks for claims held by restore rows that are pending or interrupted, and releases each one it finds.
steps.RecoveryMarksRowInterrupted: Recovery marks a pending restore row interrupted.
steps.RecoveryDoneWithRows: Recovery has no pending row left.
steps.CoreChecks: The core reads the change and checks that it is not claimed and that its files did not change since.
steps.CoreRecordsRestoreRow: The core backs up the live files and records the restore row as pending.
steps.CoreClaims: The core claims the change: `reverted_by` gets the restore row's id.
steps.CoreClosesPlan: The core finishes the journal plan.
steps.CoreFinishesFailed: The core finishes the restore row as failed.
steps.CoreFinishesDone: The core finishes the restore row as done.
steps.YouAskDesktopToUndo: You press Undo in Activity on a change the desktop wrote.
steps.DesktopChecksClaim: The desktop reads the change and sees that it is not claimed.
steps.DesktopClaims: The desktop claims the change: `reverted_by` gets the id of a restore row that does not exist yet.
steps.DesktopChecksDrift: The desktop checks that the files did not change since the change.
steps.DesktopRecordsRestoreRow: The desktop backs up the live files and records the restore row as pending.
steps.DesktopFinishesFailed: The desktop finishes the restore row as failed.
steps.DesktopFinishesDone: The desktop finishes the restore row as done.
steps.WriterDies: The app dies: a crash, a force quit or a power cut.
steps.DesktopRemovesLiveFiles: The desktop removes the live files, before it puts the old ones in.
steps.RecoveryPutsSwappedFolderBack: Recovery puts back the folder that an unfinished swap replaced.
steps.RecoveryClosesPlan: Recovery marks the journal plan reversed.
steps.CoreOpensSwapPlan: The core records the folder swap in a journal plan.
steps.CoreWritesAtOnce: The core puts the files back in one operation.
steps.CoreStartsWrite: The core starts to write: the files are half way.
steps.DesktopWritesAtOnce: The desktop puts the files back in one operation.
steps.DesktopPutsOldFilesIn: The desktop puts the old files into place.
steps.DesktopAppStarts: The desktop app starts and begins its own recovery, which releases no claim.
steps.RecoveryStartsPuttingFolderBack: Recovery starts to put back the folder that an unfinished swap replaced: the files are half way.
